title: Japanese: Hiragana and Katakana

sources.name: Original kana explanations; Japan Foundation Irodori reference

description: For beginners learning to read Japanese: 71 hiragana and 71 katakana, including voiced and p-sounds, with romaji and example words. Long vowels are written with doubled vowels.
